uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: Increases Decidueye's auto attack and move damage by 20% to distant enemies. Deals increased damage to distant enemies.

Increases the speed of auto attacks by 3% for 2.5s after one hits. This effect can stack up to 4 times, and with every third activation of this effect, auto attacks become boosted attacks for a short time. These boosted attacks fire more quills, but the damage dealt by each quill is decreased. Increases the speed of basic attacks by 3% for a short time after one hits. This effect can stack up to 4 times, and with every third activation of this effect, basic attacks become boosted attacks for a short time. These boosted attacks fire more quills, but the damage dealt by each quill is decreased.

Increases the speed of basic attacks by 3% for a short time after one hits. This effect can stack up to 4 times, and with every third activation of this effect, basic attacks become boosted attacks for a short time. These boosted attacks fire more quills, but the damage dealt by each quill is decreased.

Pelts leaves in the designated direction, dealing damage in a cone to enemies hit (only hits once). For a short time after using this move, Decidueye’s Attack is increased by 10% (this also affects Leafage) and auto attack speed is increased by 25% for 3s. Pelts leaves in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit. For a short time after using this move, Decidueye’s Attack and basic attack speed are increased.

Summons whirling razor leaves. While active, Decidueye's auto attack is replaced by a new auto attack that targets up to 2 additional enemies in range, as well as increasing Attack by 10% and auto attack speed. This buff lasts for 5.5s. Summons whirling razor leaves. For a short time after using this move, Decidueye’s Attack and basic attack speed are increased, and basic attacks can target multiple enemies for a short time.

Adds one tick of additional damage: 2% of the main target's remaining HP and 1% for secondary targets. Against All Enemies: The additional damage from remaining HP is capped at 240 on the main target and 120 on secondary targets. Increases the basic attack damage the higher the enemies remaining HP is.

Charges power before firing a large arrow in the designated direction. Damage dealt increases the longer power is charged (with 6 breakpoints and a max-charge at 1.3s), but movement speed is decreased by 25% while charging. If this move hits after power is charged to the maximum, it can stitch enemies to the ground. The affected enemy has their movement speed decreased by 80% for a short time when exiting the area, and receives damage upon leaving the area. A maximum of 3 uses can be kept in reserve for this move. There is a 2s cooldown between uses. Charges power before firing quills in the designated direction. Damage dealt increases the longer power is charged, but movement speed is decreased while charging. If this move hits after power is charged to the maximum, it can stitch enemies to the ground. The affected Pokémon receives damage upon moving a set distance from that location, and their movement speed is decreased for a short time.
Deals 15% increased damage to enemies with less than 50% remaining HP. Deals increased damage to enemies with low remaining HP.
Deals damage to enemies and decreases their movement speed by 80% for a short time. Deals damage to enemies and decreases their movement speed for a short time.

Creates a tempest of sharp leaves, dealing damage to enemies it hits and decreases their movement speed by 60% for 2.5s. The slow decays at 10% per 0.5s up to four times. At point-blank range, it also shoves and stuns enemies hit for 1s. Creates a tempest of sharp leaves, dealing damage to enemies it hits and decreases their movement speed for a short time. At point-blank range, it also shoves enemies hit.
Movement speed decrease now lasts 3.5s but still decaying up to four times at 10% per 0.5s. Increases the length of time that the movement speed of enemies is decreased.

Decidueye creates a shadow that lasts for up to 5s, increasing Decidueye's movement speed by 70% for 2s, decaying by 20% every 0.5s, and reveals all opposing Pokémon in range temporarily. Pokémon that are sneaking remain invisible but can be targeted by the shadow giving away their position if they were within the initial cast range. Afterwards the shadow will automatically target an enemy player that is visible to Decidueye, inflicting damage, lowering their movement speed by 30% for 1s, and decreasing their Defense by 40% for 1.5s. Wild Pokémon that are currently aggressive can also be targeted but are otherwise ignored. Creates a shadow that takes hold of one enemy in the area of effect, dealing damage and decreasing their movement speed and Defense for a short time. Also increases Decidueye’s movement speed for a short time.
Defense reduction of enemies is increased to 60%. Further decreases Defense.

Fires quills in the designated direction for 5s, dealing damage to enemies but does not pierce through them. The move ends by unleashing a large quill that deals damage to all enemies it hits (30% more damage if the target is below 50% HP) but Nock Nock can be cancelled early. While using this move, Decidueye becomes unstoppable but is unable to move. Fires quills in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies. The move ends by unleashing a particularly large quill that deals damage to all enemies it hits. This move deals increased damage if the enemies remaining HP is low. While using this move, Decidueye becomes immune to hindrances but is unable to move.
Buffs: 30% Max HP Shield granted at the start of the Move, 30% Movement Speed granted at the end of the turret Buff duration: 6

source.name: Nock Nock
source.originalDescription: Fires quills in the designated direction for 5s, dealing damage to enemies but does not pierce through them. The move ends by unleashing a large quill that deals damage to all enemies it hits (30% more damage if the target is below 50% HP) but Nock Nock can be cancelled early. While using this move, Decidueye becomes unstoppable but is unable to move. Fires quills in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies. The move ends by unleashing a particularly large quill that deals damage to all enemies it hits. This move deals increased damage if the enemies remaining HP is low. While using this move, Decidueye becomes immune to hindrances but is unable to move.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Nock Nock は 移動不能を付与する、妨害無効になる、妨害耐性を得る、HP割合条件で発動する、現在HP・最大HP・減少HPなどを参照する。
